Enum Class BenefitType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BenefitType>
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.enums.BenefitType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BenefitType>, Constable
public enum BenefitType extends Enum<BenefitType>
Enumerates all building benefit categories supported by the model.

Each value identifies the rule family a building card belongs to, so scoring and event logic can dispatch the correct effect implementation or lookup.
